descriptions.zh:
§H[from.GetName]§!地表崩裂，地壳破碎，难以承受的热浪从地底涌上。转变来得迅猛而彻底：群山崩溃，海洋沸腾，天空余烬弥漫。

曾经繁盛的生物群系已不复存在，唯有极端生命体仍栖息于此。
descriptions.en:
The surface of §H[from.GetName]§! has ruptured, its crust fracturing as unbearable heat surged from below. The transformation was swift and absolute: mountains collapsed, oceans boiled, and the sky was a veil of embers.

No trace remains of the planet's once-thriving biomes. Only extremophile life forms can still call this place home.

descriptions.zh:
长期以来，我们认为§Y[capital_star.GetName]§!是一颗典型红巨星，但近期分析显示，其体积和辐射排放持续增长，已对气候产生明显影响，导致人口日益恐慌。

当前趋势毫无停止迹象，为了我们物种的存续，必须查明这一现象的成因。
descriptions.en:
We have long thought of §Y[capital_star.GetName]§! as a typical red giant, but recent analysis indicates that its size and radiation emissions are increasing. These changes are already having a measurable effect on our climate and the population is growing alarmed.

The trends show no sign of stopping. If our species is to survive, we must investigate the cause of this phenomenon.

descriptions.zh:

descriptions.zh: [GetRedGiantEndingExplode]
descriptions.en: [GetRedGiantEndingExplode]

label.zh: 我们必须尽全力重建家园。
label.en: We must do whatever we can to restore our home.

descriptions.zh: 经过大规模清理，§Y[this.GetName]§!地表再次适宜嗜热者们生存。虽然部分永久性伤痕依然存在，但可最大化利用其独特的科研价值。
descriptions.en: After monumental cleanup efforts, the surface of §Y[this.GetName]§! is survivable for Thermophiles again. While some permanent scars will always remain, they can now be leveraged to their full potential for unique research opportunities.

options.script: name = ACKNOWLEDGED

descriptions.zh:
通过调校虹吸装置，从恒星外层提取氢气，并精确调控能量输入比例，我们安全逆转了§Y[Target.GetStarName]§!的膨胀，使其重新回归温和稳定的红巨星阶段。

监测结果显示，§Y[Target.GetStarName]§!气候已逐步恢复稳定。未来，宜居性有望进一步提高，而我们的母星仍将继续作为帝国的核心。

[GetRedGiantEndingKalmStationStatus]
descriptions.en:
By adjusting the siphon, extracting hydrogen from the shell, and fine-tuning the star's input ratios, we have safely reversed §Y[Target.GetStarName]§!'s expansion, restoring it to its former calm as a warm Red Giant.

We have already detected climatic stabilization on §Y[Target.GetStarName]§!, and we can look forward to a more habitable future in which our home planet continues to be the heart of our empire.

[GetRedGiantEndingKalmStationStatus]

label.en: Maintain our study of the station.

label.zh: 让它成为我们胜利的纪念碑。
label.en: Let it be a monument to our victory.

descriptions.zh:
持续观测证实§Y[Target.system_star.GetName]§!正在加速膨胀。辐射增强带来的物理影响也在陆续记录。除非找到方法阻止膨胀，否则§Y[Target.system_star.GetName]§!将在吞噬行星之前便将我们彻底消灭。

[GetMegacorpDesc65]
descriptions.en:
Ongoing observations confirm that §Y[Target.system_star.GetName]§! is expanding at an accelerating pace. Physical effects from the increased radiation are also being reported. Unless we can find a way to stop it, §Y[Target.system_star.GetName]§! will eradicate us long before it consumes the planet.

[GetMegacorpDesc65]

descriptions.zh:
我们恒星系最内侧的星球首当其冲，已被§Y[Target.GetName]§!吞噬。虽说那里的原材料依然存在，但却深陷炽烈的恒星之中，难以再度开采。

我们虽然能承受眼前的经济损失，但这场灾变所映照出的§Y[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!未来，令人不寒而栗。
descriptions.en:
§Y[Target.GetName]§! has claimed its first major victim, engulfing the innermost world of our system. Although the raw materials still exist, they now lie beyond our reach in the fiery depths of the star.

While we can weather the immediate economic loss, this provides a frightening glimpse of what awaits §Y[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh: 我们的红巨星正史无前例地膨胀，现已吞噬另一颗行星。除非恒星在剧烈的新星爆发中剥离其外层物质，否则这颗行星上的丰富资源将永远无法获取。
descriptions.en: Our Red Giant's unprecedented growth has now consumed another planet. Its rich resources will remain forever inaccessible, unless the star sheds its outer layers in a violent nova.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[capital_star.GetName]§!的真相远比我们想象的更诡异。持续调查发现，恒星深处隐藏着一对亚空间隧道

其中一条将富含氢的物质直接输送至外层，加速聚变反应并增加氦的产量。这本该使核心收缩，然而另一条隧道却主动虹吸能量，抵消了收缩效应，令恒星持续膨胀。

初步遥测数据表明，两条隧道连接星系中多个区域。我们的存亡，取决于能否及时探明这些通道的彼端。
descriptions.en:
The truth about §Y[capital_star.GetName]§! is stranger than we imagined. Ongoing investigations have revealed a twinned pair of subspace tunnels deep within our star.

One of these channels hydrogen-rich material directly into the outer shell, accelerating fusion and increasing helium production. This should drive core compression, but the second tunnel actively siphons energy, counteracting the process. The result is the expansion of the star.

Initial telemetry from both subspace tunnels suggests they connect to multiple endpoints scattered across the galaxy. Our survival depends on investigating these as soon as possible.

label.zh: 我们需调查其中三个位置。
label.en: We'll need to investigate three of these locations.

tooltips.zh: 已定位可用于三角定位亚空间起源的可行目标。
tooltips.en: Viable targets for triangulation of the subspace origin have been located.

descriptions.zh:
围绕§Y[FromFromFrom.GetName]§!的天体测量扫描发现无法解释的亚空间创伤。虽然该地目前尚无出口，但过去在围绕这颗气态巨行星的轨道上可能出现过一条隧道。这些数据提供了可应用于其他领域的物理见解。

同时，我们必须去其他地方寻找，以确定恒星内活跃的亚空间隧道的来源。
descriptions.en:
Astrometric scans around §Y[FromFromFrom.GetName]§! revealed unexplained subspace scarring. While there is currently no exit point at this location, a past tunnel may have opened in orbit around this gas giant. The data has provided physics insights that could be applied in other areas. 

In the meantime, we will have to look elsewhere to determine the source of the subspace tunnels at work within our star.

descriptions.zh:
围绕§Y[FromFromFrom.GetName]§!的扫描表明存在亚空间创伤。我们还在行星附近发现了古代废金属堆。这些废料稳定位于轨道上，可能与创伤相关。

持续扫描这些亚空间波动应有助于优化母恒星周围的太阳能阵列。

虽然这些数据有所帮助，但我们至少还需要调查一个地点，才能锁定问题根源。
descriptions.en:
The scans around §Y[FromFromFrom.GetName]§! indicate subspace scarring. We have also identified pockets of ancient scrap metal near the planet. These are orbitally locked into position, and may be related to the scarring. 

Ongoing scans of these subspace fluctuations should help us to optimize the solar arrays around our home star.

While this data has been helpful, we need at least one more survey location to lock down the present source of our problems.

descriptions.zh:
终于取得重大突破。

围绕§Y[FromFromFrom.GetName]§!的进一步创伤发现让我们得以通过三角定位，将恒星异常的源头锁定到一个带有敌意信号的未知星系。

这项发现或许最终能帮助我们抵御干扰恒星的未知力量。

如果能进入§Y卢瑟斯§!恒星系，也许就能改写§Y[FromFromFromFrom.Target.solar_system.GetName]§!乃至整个文明的命运。
descriptions.en:
At last, a real breakthrough.

Further scarring around §Y[FromFromFrom.GetName]§! allowed us to triangulate the origin of our star's disturbance to a previously undetected system with hostile signatures.

This investigation may eventually help us to counteract whatever is affecting our star.

Once we advance into the §YLusus§! system, we may be able to change the fate of §Y[FromFromFromFrom.Target.solar_system.GetName]§!, and of our civilization.

descriptions.zh:
派往调查发光柱的探测器确定，柱体由可塑硅酸盐岩浆形成。该物质通过基岩裂隙被推升，尚未突破地表即固化，形成的结构可以达数百米，最终因自重坍塌。

如此形成一片由几近纯净透明的火山玻璃构成的尖塔森林，每座尖塔都折射着下方依然翻滚的熔融岩浆发出的暖橙色光芒。

科学家[Leader.GetName]推测这些坍塌尖塔的残骸可能成为宝贵资源。
descriptions.en:
Probes dispatched to investigate the glowing pillars have determined they are formed from a malleable silicate magma. This material is forced upward through bedrock vents, solidifying before it breaches the surface. The resulting structures can grow hundreds of meters tall before their weight causes them to collapse.

The result is a veritable forest of spires composed of nearly pure, transparent volcanic glass, each one refracting the warm orange glow of the molten magma still churning below.

Scientist [Leader.GetName] posits that the remnants of these collapsed spires could serve as a valuable resource.

label.en: Leave this divine place in peace.
Place a bid on an extraction permit.

descriptions.zh:
时间与地表范围内均确认大气化学波动，且在行星巨大的裸露岩浆海上空最为强烈，因此派遣探测器前往采样。

进一步分析后，[Leader.GetName]确认[Planet.GetName]上的岩浆海正在释放珍稀的异星天然气。这一意外发现表明，若能成功开发，该行星或将成为我方工业的潜在资源供给。
descriptions.en:
Chemical fluctuations in the atmosphere were confirmed across both time and the surface. The fluctuations were strongest over the planet's large ocean of exposed magma, so a probe was dispatched to collect samples.

Upon closer analysis, [Leader.GetName] determined that the magma ocean on [Planet.GetName] is outgassing valuable exotic gasses. This unexpected finding suggests that the planet could be a potential contributor to our industries, if we are able to exploit it.

descriptions.zh:
[Planet.GetName]表面的首批图像揭示了震撼且出乎意料的地质构造，称为“晶体熔岩湖”。这些岩浆体存在已久，内含的特殊矿物可在特定温度范围内自然自排列为晶体结构。因此，湖面显得极为透明，并泛起红色系虹彩。受行星轨道影响，这种视觉效果伴随季节温度变化呈周期性波动。

晶体熔岩湖的美丽景色可能吸引大量游客。湖中的晶体矿物可于活跃期采集，用于开发能量储存介质。
descriptions.en:
Our first images from the surface of [Planet.GetName] have revealed stunning and unexpected geological formations that are being called 'crystal lava lakes'. These long-lived bodies of magma are infused with unique minerals that, within a specific temperature range, naturally self-arrange into crystalline matrices. The result is exceptional transparency and red-spectrum iridescence across the lake. Due to the planet's orbit, this visually striking effect ebbs and flows on a seasonal cycle as temperatures fluctuate.

The aesthetic appeal of these crystal lava lakes could prove to be a powerful draw for tourists. The crystalline minerals themselves could also be skimmed from the surface during their active season, after which their properties could be leveraged for energy storage media.

label.zh: 将此地开发为度假胜地。
label.en: Develop the site as a resort

descriptions.zh:
[Planet.GetName]最初被评定为典型的岩浆烈焰星球，然而调查发现，在行星表面纵横交错的裂谷中，存在复杂的本地植物生态系统。这些植物能够产生氧气并收集少有的水分，在炽热的荒原之中形成近乎温带的微气候区域。

这一生态系统为原本无法在火山星球上生存的物种创造出适合栖息的环境，植被本身也可能适宜农业开发。建议定居者深入峡谷，对其中的生物进行详尽探索。
descriptions.en:
Initial assessment of [Planet.GetName] characterized it as a world of magma and fire, but surveys have revealed a native ecosystem of complex flora inhabiting a network of rift valleys across the planet. These plants produce oxygen and collect what little moisture exists, resulting in pockets of almost temperate microclimates in an otherwise superheated wasteland.

The biomes supported by this flora could prove habitable for species that otherwise avoid settling volcanic worlds, and the flora itself may be suitable for agriculture. It would benefit any settlers to thoroughly explore what exactly lives in those canyons.

label.zh: 标记区域为适宜定居区。
label.en: Mark area as viable settlement zone

tooltips.zh: 添加提升宜居性容忍度与生长率的行星修正。
tooltips.en: Adds a planetary modifier improving Habitability Tolerance and Growth.

descriptions.zh:
[Leader.GetName]报告称，在§Y[from.GetName]§!火山表面之下存在广袤的冰川，被隔热特性极佳的特殊矿物岩层包裹。构造活动正缓慢破坏这些隔热层，[Leader.GetName]预测，若冰川与星体其他区域温度趋于平衡，该行星将大幅降温，从火山星球转变为干旱星球，

我们可以加速此过程，提高其宜居性。不过该现象颇具科学价值，也可使其自然演，方便进行研究。
descriptions.en:
[Leader.GetName] reports that beneath the volcanic surface of §Y[from.GetName]§! are vast glaciers. They are encased in unusual rock formations composed of minerals with exceptional insulating properties. Tectonic activity is slowly degrading these insulating layers, and [Leader.GetName] predicts that if temperatures between the glaciers and the rest of the planet were to equalize, the planet would cool enough to be considered an arid world, rather than a volcanic one.

We can speed up this process in order to make the planet somewhat more habitable. But the phenomenon is scientifically curious, and there may be value in allowing it to be studied as it proceeds naturally.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.GetName]§!独特的构造与地质特征，造就了罕见而壮丽的奇观。行星大部分区域是酷热的沙漠，充斥着火山烟雾与流动的熔岩。一块巨大坚固的大陆岩石板块从地壳中隆起，高耸于地表数十公里。由此形成的高原凌驾于有毒云层之上，孕育着本地动植物，形成繁荣的生态系统。

该高原不仅适宜许多物种栖息，还可能蕴藏着惊人的科学奥秘。
descriptions.en:
The unique composition and tectonics of §Y[from.GetName]§! has created an unparalleled marvel. While most of the planet is a hot desert clogged with volcanic smog and free-flowing lava, one massive continental plate of solid rock rises dozens of kilometers above the average surface. The resulting highlands, high above the layer of toxic clouds, are home to a verdant green ecosystem of native plants and animals.

This plateau would be readily habitable for many species and could hold a number of fascinating scientific insights if it were to be studied.

descriptions.zh:
[Leader.GetName]已确认，该奇特形态为熔岩漩涡。这类现象极为罕见，且记录中从未有过如此规模。[Leader.GetName]震惊于此奇特现象，下令展开采样任务。

样品显示，漩涡活动部分由稳定的活体金属池支持：活体金属被水流撕裂后试图重组，重组过程进一步扰动熔岩，维持漩涡活动。采样还表明，采集该活体金属相对容易。
descriptions.en:
[Leader.GetName] has confirmed the strange shape to be a lava whirlpool. These are exceedingly rare, and none of this size has ever been recorded. Struck by the strange phenomenon, [Leader.GetName] ordered a sampling mission.

The samples reveal that the whirlpool is in part sustained by a steady pool of Living Metal, which is torn apart by the currents and then attempts to reconstitute itself. That reconstitution further disturbs the lava, continuing the whirlpool's motion. The sampling also demonstrates that this Living Metal could be harvested with little effort.

descriptions.zh:
[Leader.GetName]报告发现一个有棱角的刚性结构体悬浮于恒星稳定轨道中。该结构体由未知材料组成，表面具有类似晶体结构的棱面，成分无法分析。它保持固定方向，始终面向其恒星，抵抗所有外力操控或旋转。

在一项受控实验中，调查船对该结构体发射集束脉冲，致其整齐裂开，分裂成两个对称半体，每个半体又各自重构为原结构体的小型复制体。后续脉冲产生相同效果：分裂、复制及稳定微缩。

最后，众多微型结构体分散形成一片云，稳定漂浮于轨道上。每一块碎片都保留了原结构体的精确排列与几何特征，整体则还原了原始结构轮廓。

此现象前所未有且无法解释。所有数据均已归档，待深入分析。
descriptions.en:
[Leader.GetName] reported the discovery of a rigid, angular construct suspended in stable stellar orbit. Composed of an unknown material and marked by faceted planes reminiscent of crystalline structures, the object resisted all compositional analysis. It remained locked in a fixed orientation, perpetually facing its parent star, and withstood all attempts at manipulation or rotation.

During a controlled experiment, the survey vessel subjected the object to a concentrated energy pulse. The construct fractured cleanly, splitting into two symmetrical halves, each of which reconfigured into a smaller replica of the original. Subsequent pulses produced identical outcomes: division, replication, and consistent miniaturization.

Eventually, a diffuse cloud of miniature constructs stabilized in orbit. Each fragment retained the precise alignment and geometry of the progenitor, and the swarm as a whole mirrored the original structure's silhouette.

The phenomenon remains entirely without precedent or explanation. All collected telemetry has been archived for further analysis.

descriptions.zh:
科研团队抵达[from.GetName]追踪该信号，确认其来自一地下洞穴系统，洞内配有科研设备。

[Leader.GetName]率队深入洞穴，发现一个由未知合金封闭的密室，里面传出微弱的鸣响。[GetMysteriousRingingDesc3210]

配备听觉防护装备进入后，众人发现一物种未知的生物正在沉眠，其身旁正是信号来源：一个奇特的圆柱形装置。

分析结果表明，该装置会定期发射无线电脉冲，并在数小时内发出类似音乐的声音，以及类似该生物的声音。[Leader.GetName]推测其目的是依照固定的时间表唤醒该生物。
descriptions.en:
A science team arrived on [from.GetName] to track down the signal, and determined that it was coming from an underground cave system outfitted with scientific observation equipment.

[Leader.GetName] led the team into the caverns, where they found a chamber sealed off by unfamiliar alloys, with a faint ringing coming from within. [GetMysteriousRingingDesc3210]

Once audioprotective equipment was issued, the team entered and found a creature of unknown species hibernating next to the source of the signal: an odd cylindrical device.

Analysis determined the device emits regular radio bursts, followed by several hours of melodic noise overlaid with vocalizations, which appear compatible with the creature's vocal anatomy. [Leader.GetName] speculates the device may be trying to rouse the creature in accordance with a set schedule.

label.zh: 复制其研究资料后撤离。
尝试唤醒并招募该生物。
label.en: Try to wake and hire the creature.

tooltips.zh: 领袖获得：£scientist£§Y科学官§!，起始等级§G4§!。
工人受益于频繁让他们回去工作的提醒。解锁决策：§G+10%§!£job£['concept_jobs']产出，§R-5%§!£happiness£['concept_happiness']。
tooltips.en: Our workers will benefit from frequent reminders to get back to work. Unlocks a decision granting §G+10%§! £job£ ['concept_jobs'] output at the cost of §R-5%§! £happiness£ ['concept_happiness'].

descriptions.zh:
定向扫描发现§Y[root.capital_scope.GetName]§!地表下埋藏着精密设施，且越靠近核心处，设施的规模越大，复杂度越高。它们的材质和能量特征与我们首次苏醒时的休眠舱一致。

这些必定是我们前文明的遗迹。若能进入这些设施，或许解答关于我们过去的最大谜团：我们是谁？经历了什么？
descriptions.en:
Targeted scans have found evidence of sophisticated facilities buried beneath the surface of §Y[root.capital_scope.GetName]§!, increasing in size and complexity as they approach the core. Their material and energy signatures match those of the stasis chamber where we first awoke.

These must be remnants of our previous civilization. If we can access these facilities, we may find answers to the greatest questions about our past: who are we, and what happened to us?

descriptions.zh: 我们发现了更多存有活体§Y[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!的休眠舱，正试图唤醒他们，但他们对过去似乎也没有太多头绪。
descriptions.en: We've uncovered more stasis pods containing living §Y[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!. We are in the process of waking them, but they appear to have no clearer sense of the past than we do.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现了更多存有活体§Y[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!的休眠舱。即使融合后，他们显然也没有有用的记忆。
descriptions.en: We've uncovered more stasis pods containing living §Y[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!. Even after integration, it is clear that they are devoid of useful memories.

descriptions.zh:
不断发现更多休眠舱，我们发现记忆几乎完全丧失。

部分新唤醒的亲族问我们同样的问题：你是谁？

尽管历经数个世纪，社会日益发达，但我们并没有比他们更接近答案。

与休眠者不同，他们的数据库中竟保存着惊人的新信息。我们经过反复分析，确认结果无误。数据显示，自我们首次进入休眠以来，已经过了超过120亿年。

这意味着我们的起源可以追溯到宇宙最初的年代，那是第一批恒星与行星方才诞生的时代。也许，我们正是这片宇宙中最早进化出的智慧生命之一。
descriptions.en:
As we continue to uncover more stasis pods, we find that the loss of memory is almost complete.

Some of our newly awakened kin have asked the very question we now ponder: who are you?

Despite centuries of history and an increasingly developed society, we can not claim to be any closer to the answer than they are.

Unlike the sleepers, their databases do hold stunning new information. We replicated the analysis several times to confirm, but the results are undeniable. The data suggests that over twelve billion years have passed since we first entered stasis.

This places our origins close to the beginning of the universe, amidst the formation of the earliest stars and planets. We might be among the very first sentients to ever evolve.

descriptions.zh:
不断发现更多休眠舱，我们发现记忆几乎完全丧失。

沉睡的亲族被唤醒后，也与其他亲族一样，不记得我们的起源。如果没有答案，那我们只能自创历史道路。

与休眠者不同，他们的数据库中竟保存着惊人的新信息。我们经过反复分析，确认结果无误。数据显示，自我们首次进入休眠以来，已经过了超过120亿年。

这意味着我们的起源可以追溯到宇宙最初的年代，那是第一批恒星与行星方才诞生的时代。也许，我们正是这片宇宙中最早进化出的智慧生命之一。
descriptions.en:
As we continue to uncover more stasis pods, we find that the loss of memory is almost complete.

Once awakened, these sleeping kin continue to lack pertinent memories about our origins, as with the others. In the absence of answers, we are forced to chart our own course through history.

Unlike the sleepers, their databases do hold stunning new information. We replicated the analysis several times to confirm, but the results are undeniable. The data suggests that over twelve billion years have passed since we first entered stasis.

This places our origins close to the beginning of the universe, amidst the formation of the earliest stars and planets. We might be among the very first sentients to ever evolve.

label.en: Catch up on what we've missed.

descriptions.zh:
我们发掘出一场悲剧。来自这个完整冻存舱设施的记录显示，§Y[event_target:homeworld.GetName]§!在被其当前恒星捕获前漂流了数十亿年。那次捕获触发了巨大的潮汐涌动。

尽管那些力量铸就了我们现在称之为家的火山乐园，初始冲击却严重破坏了设施的电池。自动化系统优先保障高阶个体，关闭了低阶舱和结构维护。

我们的[GetScientistPlural]预测在激活破坏泄漏电源并导致隧道全面坍塌前，可能只能救出一名个体。

若非等级制度决定优先权，我们或许能救出更多人。
descriptions.en:
We have excavated a tragedy. Logs from this intact stasis pod facility reveal that §Y[event_target:homeworld.GetName]§! spent billions of years adrift before being captured by its current star. That capture triggered a massive tidal surge.

Though those forces forged the volcanic paradise we now call home, the initial shockwave critically ruptured the facility's power cells. Automated systems prioritized high-ranking individuals, shutting down lower-status pods and structural maintenance. 

Our [GetScientistPlural] predict that only one individual can be rescued before activation compromises the leaking power supply and cascades into a full tunnel collapse. 

Had hierarchy not dictated priority, we might have saved many more.

label.zh: 优先保护专家，明智之举。
label.en: Prioritizing experts was a good choice.

label.zh: 在不触发激活的情况下拆除电池。

tooltips.zh: 个体是可以替代的，但我们的帝国需要空间成长。
tooltips.en: Individuals are replaceable, but our empire needs space to grow.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[event_target:leader.GetName]§!正在重建他们的冻存档案。他们最新的发现表明，许多小型[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]族群可能像我们曾经那样散布在银河系中，以冻存形式保存着。

档案记录了这些星球的位置，但自那时起已有整颗恒星诞生与消亡，要定位它们现在需要复杂的插值法。作为概念验证，[event_target:leader.GetName]已识别出一个此类行星，但翻译完整数据集才刚刚开始。

与此同时，一个令人不安的想法浮现：[root.Capital.GetStarName]或许并非我们的真正母星，而只是众多避难所之一。如果是这样，我们的起源在哪里？那还重要吗？
descriptions.en:
§Y[event_target:leader.GetName]§! is reconstructing their stasis archives. Their latest findings suggest numerous minor [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] populations may be scattered across the galaxy, preserved in stasis as we once were.

The archives recorded these worlds' positions, but with entire stars born and lost since, locating them now requires complex interpolation. As proof of concept, [event_target:leader.GetName] has identified one such planet, but translating the full dataset is only beginning.

Meanwhile, a troubling thought arises: [root.Capital.GetStarName] may not be our true home star, but merely one refuge among many. If so, where is our origin? And does it still matter?

label.zh: 我们必须找到我们的同胞。
这颗星球现在就是我们的家园。
label.en: This world is our home now.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[root.leader.GetName]§!发现了一个地下住房设施，那里有更多处于冻存的同胞，并成功唤醒了他们。与我们不同，他们保留着对前世的模糊记忆，并以一个可能有朝一日会回来救他们的伟大太空帝国的故事为生。

他们很谨慎，但认我们为同胞。我们可以把自己展现为他们期待已久的救星，成为那古老荣耀的继承者。或者我们可以说实话：我们正在打造一些新的东西，同样渴望向他们学习，也愿意教导他们。

这些档案中的额外线索让我们缩小了第二个拥有冻存舱候选行星的范围。
descriptions.en:
§Y[root.leader.GetName]§! discovered an underground facility housing more of our kin in stasis, and successfully awakened them. Unlike us, they retain faint memories of their previous lives, and are sustained by stories of a great space empire that might one day return to rescue them.

They are cautious but recognize us as kin. We could present ourselves as their long-awaited saviors, heirs to that ancient glory. Or we could tell the truth: we are forging something new, and as eager to learn from them as we are to teach.

Additional references in these archives allowed us to narrow down a second candidate with stasis pods.

label.zh: 我们是他们古老的救世主。

descriptions.zh:
§Y[root.leader.GetName]§!发现了更多处于冻存的同胞并成功唤醒他们，但他们以恐惧回应，要求我们离开。他们既不认同我们为同胞，也不欢迎我们的存在。

经过紧张的谈判，他们表达了离开并探索银河的愿望。我们可以以低价提供一艘简单飞船。或者，鉴于我们对劳动力的持续需求，我们把他们迁移到最近的殖民地。也许那时他们会明白理由。

该设施的档案显示另一颗有更多冻存舱的星球位置。
descriptions.en:
§Y[root.leader.GetName]§! discovered more of our kin in stasis and succeeded in waking them, but they responded with fear, demanding we leave. They neither recognized us as kin nor welcomed our presence.

After tense negotiation, they expressed a desire to leave and explore the galaxy. We could offer them a simple ship at a modest cost. Or, given our constant need for labor, we relocate them to the nearest colony. Perhaps then they'll see reason.

The archives of this facility shows the location of another world with more stasis pods.

descriptions.zh:
拿走我们船只的休眠者归来，驾驭着庞大战舰。他们在星系之旅中与海盗发生冲突，并最终以智谋击败了敌人。

夺取敌舰激发了他们对海盗行为的渴望，自此掠夺更加大胆，目标也更强大。但即便再成功，海盗生活终究不是长久之计。

如今，他们归来，寻求稳定或更伟大的事物。凭借现有的舰船、经验和战利品，他们依然非常有价值。
descriptions.en:
The sleepers who took our vessel have returned, aboard a massive warship, no less. Their journey across the galaxy brought them into conflict with pirates, who they outwitted and ultimately overthrew.

Seizing the enemy ship sparked something in them: a taste for piracy. From there, their raids grew bolder, their targets more powerful. But even successful piracy can't last forever.

Now they've come home, seeking stability, and perhaps something greater. With their ship, experience, and spoils, they could yet prove very useful.

tooltips.zh: 我们可以用他们的舰船壮大舰队。获得一艘巡洋舰。
tooltips.en: We could use their ship in our fleet. We gain a Cruiser.

label.zh: 改装他们的舰船，用来开拓新星球。
label.en: Retrofit their ship to settle a new world for us.

label.zh: 我们在首都还有地方容纳他们。
label.en: We have space for them at our capital.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[root.leader.GetName]§!发现了一个较小的停滞设施，以及一个隐藏的星港，里面有一艘几乎可以正常工作的科学船。小修一下就够了。

该地点还保存着大量的科学数据，包括保存下来的其他物种的标本[GetInterstellarRefugiaDesc2535]目前尚不清楚这些标本是被强行带走还是自愿提供的，但这艘船上有专门为有感性货物设计的拘留室。

通过研究它们，我们可以收获很多，也许还有更多的生命形式有待发现。
descriptions.en:
§Y[root.leader.GetName]§! uncovered a smaller stasis facility, along with a hidden starport housing a nearly functional science vessel. Minor repairs will suffice.

The site also held a trove of scientific data, including preserved specimens from other species[GetInterstellarRefugiaDesc2535] It's unclear if these were taken by force or given willingly, but the vessel includes holding cells designed for sentient cargo.

We stand to gain much by studying them, perhaps there may even be more lifeforms still to be discovered out there.

label.en: Return the specimens to their relatives.

descriptions.zh:
最新挖掘带来惊人发现：这批休眠者在几个世纪前已然苏醒，却从未离开设施。

建筑分析显示，设施从外部上锁，似乎是为囚禁他们。我们在切开加固门时遭到袭击，不过休眠者随后就撤退了。

档案或许能提供线索，但查阅档案可能加剧冲突。我们可以选择强攻设施以快速解决，或尝试通过贿赂争取他们的合作。
descriptions.en:
Our latest excavation revealed a surprise: this group of sleepers awoke centuries ago, but never left their facility.

Architectural analysis shows it locks from the outside, seemingly to contain them. Cutting through the reinforced doors, we were instantly met with hostility, though the sleepers have since withdrawn.

The archives may explain this, but access risks further provocation. We could storm the facility and end the matter swiftly, or attempt to bribe them into cooperation.

descriptions.zh:
我们的部队冲入了设施，迅速制服了大多数居民，只遇到轻微抵抗。

档案显示这是一所监狱。被囚者是极端分子，主张极端的技术手段以重新加热正在冷却的宇宙，有些极不切实际，另一些则可能带来灾难性后果。

一些§Y[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!监狱领袖已带着炸药把自己死守在中央密室，要求所有居民留下并被重新封存。

可以用一种无形气体冲洗隧道，使炸药失效以保全结构，但会导致大多数居民很快窒息。
descriptions.en:
Our forces stormed the facility and quickly subdued most inhabitants, meeting only light resistance.

The archives reveal this was a prison. The captives were extremists who had advocated for extreme technological efforts to reheat the cooling universe, some wildly impractical, others potentially catastrophic. 

Some §Y[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! prison leaders have barricaded themselves in a central chamber with explosives, demanding all inhabitants stay and be resealed.

The tunnel could be filled with an invisible gas that makes the explosive inert to save the structures, but would cause most inhabitants to suffocate soon after.

descriptions.zh:
数月的贸易之后，这些曾处于休眠状态的囚徒开始依赖我方供应。我们威胁切断供应时，他们便惊慌失措，交出了设施的控制权。

档案确认这里曾经是监狱。这些人曾极力推动用极端科技让宇宙回暖，其中一些想法荒诞不经，另一些虽然可能，却非常危险。

幸而，他们对这些往事毫无记忆。科学家在现场观察时发现，这些曾经的囚徒正逐步融入社会，缓慢实现同化。
descriptions.en:
Months of trade left the former stasis inmates reliant on our supplies. When we threatened to end it, they panicked and ceded control of the facility.

Archives confirm it was a prison. These individuals once pushed for radical technologies to reheat the cooling universe: some ideas absurd, others dangerously practical.

Fortunately, they remember none of this. As scientists study the site, the former inmates are integrating into society, well on their way to assimilation.

descriptions.zh:
最新挖掘点发生事故。设施发电站受损，但休眠舱尚保持运行。

怀疑指向最近在先前设施中同化的嗜热类。有流言称他们工作不够勤勉。

不清楚系统还能运行多久。若想救援休眠者，必须在设施断电前行动。
descriptions.en:
An accident has struck the site of the latest excavation. The power station in the facility has been damaged, though the stasis pods are still active for now.

Suspicion has fallen on some of the recently assimilated Thermophiles from the previous facility. It is rumored they may not have been the most diligent of workers.

It is unclear how much longer the systems will remain operational. If we want to rescue the sleepers, we need to act before the facility runs out of power.

descriptions.zh:
最新挖掘点发生事故。设施发电站受损，但休眠舱尚保持运行。

听闻这场灾难，先前获救的嗜热类主动提出协助加速救援进程。

不清楚系统还能运行多久。若想救援休眠者，必须在设施断电前行动。
descriptions.en:
An accident has struck the site of the latest excavation. The power station in the facility has been damaged, though the stasis pods are still active for now.

Hearing of this disaster, the previous community of rescued Thermophiles have volunteered to help speed the rescue process.

It is unclear how much longer the systems will remain operational. If we want to rescue the sleepers, we need to act before the facility runs out of power.

descriptions.zh:
我们仅允许最忠诚的劳工进入，以最大限度减少干扰。

遗憾的是，安全检查限制了人力，未能挽救设施，休眠者全部丧生。

唯一的慰藉在于研究这项技术。它的缓慢衰退与停摆或将提供宝贵洞见。
descriptions.en:
We restricted access to only our most loyal workers, minimizing disruption to the rescue effort.

Unfortunately, security screening limited our manpower, and we failed to save the facility. The sleepers have perished.

Our only consolation lies in studying the technology. Its gradual decay and shutdown may yield valuable insights.

descriptions.zh:
我们为救援工作提供奖金，收到了大量申请。

但很不幸，因对我们利用财富施加控制感到愤懑，前囚犯进行了破坏，导致所有休眠者死亡。

所幸破坏具有针对性，我们依然可以研究科技与档案。这次失败暴露出筛选流程中的漏洞，现在可以着手改进。
descriptions.en:
We offered financial rewards for rescue work and received a surge of applicants.

Unfortunately, the effort was sabotaged by former prison inmates, resentful of our use of wealth to exert control. The sabotage led to the death of all stasis pod inhabitants.

A small consolation is that the damage was targeted. We can still study the technology and archives, and this failure has exposed flaws in our screening that can now be addressed.

descriptions.zh:
大量工人和救援队涌向地下设施，使我们能够快速且安全地从即将失效的冻存舱中救出沉睡的[Species.GetName]。这些新公民看到他们所逃离的命运，对救援心存感激。

遗憾的是，匆忙过程中，许多休眠舱被破坏或打开，削弱了科研价值。
descriptions.en:
A swell of workers and rescue crews to the underground facility allowed us to quickly and safely extract the sleeping [Species.GetName] from their failing stasis pods. These new citizens, seeing the fate they escaped, are grateful for the rescue.

Unfortunately, in the course of the hasty rescue, many of the stasis pods had to be cut open or otherwise destroyed, limiting their scientific value.

descriptions.zh:
大量工人和救援队涌向地下设施，使我们能够快速且安全地从即将失效的冻存舱中救出沉睡的[Species.GetName]。这些新公民看到他们所逃离的命运，对救援心存感激。

此外，已同化的囚徒志愿者辅助新来者对话，为他们提供物资，促进他们融入社会。

遗憾的是，匆忙过程中，许多休眠舱被破坏或打开，削弱了科研价值。
descriptions.en:
A swell of workers and rescue crews to the underground facility allowed us to quickly and safely extract the sleeping [Species.GetName] from their failing stasis pods. These new citizens, seeing the fate they escaped, are grateful for the rescue.

In addition, it appears the volunteers from the prison assimilation have been supporting these newcomers with dialogue and supplies, easing their integration into society.

Unfortunately, in the course of the hasty rescue, many of the stasis pods had to be cut open or otherwise destroyed, limiting their scientific value.

label.zh: 幸好有这些增援的志愿者。
label.en: It's a good thing we had those extra volunteers.

descriptions.zh:
我们的科学家在尝试营救休眠人口之前，仔细分析了各系统，确保对所面对的一切有充分了解。

可惜，从分析到发表再到后续研究的过程耗时过长。等我们准备就绪时，生命维持系统已失效，最终无人生还。

虽然结果令人痛惜，但这场救援行动仍带来了重要的科学成果，所回收的技术本身就具有极高的价值。
descriptions.en:
Our scientists carefully analyzed the systems, ensuring that we had a full understanding of what we were dealing with before attempting a rescue of the sleeping population.

Sadly, the process from analysis, to publication, to follow-up studies took too long. By the time we were ready, life support had failed, and all lives were lost.

Though tragic, the rescue yielded major scientific gains, and the recovered technology is already proving valuable.

label.zh: 所幸活着的人还能得益。
label.en: Thankfully the living can still benefit.

descriptions.zh:
我们终于到达了中央核心，其规模令人难以置信。行星内部存在一个庞大的弧形建筑群，由岩浆提供动力，容纳着数千名休眠者。

它还保存着记录我们过去的巨大档案：我们银河帝国的崛起，以及来自宇宙大冷却时期的声音。有些人选择了冻存，有些人与不可避免的命运抗争，许多人则否认现实而死去。

这批宝藏揭示了埋葬已久的真相。有些人认为它证明了我们的真实身份以及我们未来可能成为谁。另一些人则认为我们已经铸就了新的、成功的身份，祖先的社会不再适应今日的宇宙。

无论如何，庞大的隧道网络都可以用于我们所选择的用途。
descriptions.en:
We have finally reached the central core, and its scale beggars belief. A vast arcology lies within the planet, powered by magma and housing thousands of sleepers.

It also holds immense archives chronicling our past: the rise of our galactic empire, and voices from the universe's great cooling. Some chose stasis, others fought the inevitable, and many simply denied reality and perished.

This trove reveals long-buried truths. Some believe it demonstrates who we truly are, and who we might yet become. Others argue we have forged a new, successful identity, and that the society of our ancestors is no longer suited to the universe of today.

Either way, the vast tunnel network can be put to a use of our choosing.

label.en: We should rebuild our ancient empire.

label.en: Other empires should respect our legacy.

descriptions.zh:
地质警报系统已发出预警§Y[planet.GetName]§!主定居点附近一年内可能发生火山喷发。

我们可以投入资源进行控制性减压，利用熔岩流进行地热发电，同时安排人手待命，在喷发时采集岩浆以提炼贵金属；或者集中转移区域内平民与物资，尽可能降低风险。

鉴于预测可能存在误差，我们也可以暂不采取行动，继续观测。
descriptions.en:
Geological alert systems warn that a volcanic eruption near the main settlement on §Y[planet.GetName]§! is likely to occur within the next year.

Investing in a controlled pressure release could allow the lava flow to be harnessed for energy production. Crews could also be put on standby to harvest magma directly from the eruption and strain it for precious metals. Alternatively, we could focus on evacuating civilians and supplies from the area to minimize risk.

We can also continue to monitor the situation before committing to any action, in case the predictions are inaccurate.

descriptions.zh: 提前撤离殖民地确实是上策。火山比预期提前爆发，严重损坏建筑。地底压力减小后，殖民者可安全返回重建。
descriptions.en: The early evacuation of the colony turned out to be a good choice. The volcano erupted sooner than expected, severely damaging the buildings in the area. Now that the underground volcanic pressure is minimal, the colonists can return and safely rebuild.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 火山提前爆发，殖民地措手不及，基础设施遭受严重破坏，人员伤亡惨重。
descriptions.en: The volcano exploded early, and the colony was not prepared to deal with the catastrophe. Massive damage occurred to infrastructure, and loss of life was significant.

descriptions.zh: 数月后，§Y[planet.GetName]§!殖民地附近火山活动减弱。尽管长期安全风险仍未消除，但殖民地目前暂时安全。
descriptions.en: After a few months, volcanic activity near the §Y[planet.GetName]§! colony has subsided again. While the long-term safety risk has not disappeared, it appears the colony is safe for the time being.

descriptions.zh: 工程队已完成安全系统建设，成功将地下高压熔岩缓慢释放，并通过发电装置将其能量转化为电力，短期内显著提升了殖民地电网效率。
descriptions.en: Engineering crews were able to establish a safe system for slowly releasing pressurized lava from the underground chambers, passing it through power generators as it went. This has resulted in a short-term boon to the colony's electrical grid.

descriptions.zh: 火山喷发被超声干扰器和物理屏障阻断，大量岩浆停留在地表并逐渐硬化。开采队已开始开采矿藏。
descriptions.en: The volcanic eruption was interrupted by a combination of ultrasonic disruptors and physical barriers, resulting in a large field of magma contained and hardening on the surface. Mining crews have already begun harvesting this mineral bounty.

descriptions.zh:
有人可能认为没人愿意靠近奔涌的开放熔岩流，可在§Y[planet.GetName]§!则不然。

殖民者驾驶悬浮艇沿活跃的熔岩流竞速，躲避漂浮巨石，加速越过熔岩瀑布。有人押注赛果，赌馆甚至吸引了有组织犯罪。少数飞行员甚至在各种事故中丧生。

法律对此行为并无禁止，因为从未想过有人会如此冒险。我们可以纵容殖民者的热情，任其自由，但随着赌博活动日益猖獗，这可能引发更危险的行为乃至犯罪。或者，我们可以规范这项运动，虽会引来抱怨，但长远看可减少伤亡与犯罪。还可以直接全面禁止，虽能奏效，但执行成本高昂。
descriptions.en:
One might think individuals would not want to spend time near open, quick-moving lava flows. At least on §Y[planet.GetName]§!, one would be wrong.

Colonists are racing utility hovercraft along active lava flows, dodging floating boulders and boosting themselves over lavafalls. Others are gambling on the outcomes of these races, and gambling dens have drawn the interest of organized crime. A few pilots have even died in a variety of accidents.

The colony has no laws against this practice, since it was never imagined anyone would do such a thing. We could embrace the colonists' enthusiasm and let them do as they please, but this may lead to ever more dangerous feats, and a potential criminal component, as gambling on these events is already on the rise. Alternatively, we could regulate the sport; while this may cause some grumbling, it should minimize deaths and crime in the long term. Or we could ban it outright, which would be effective, but costly to enforce.

descriptions.zh:
允许殖民者追逐这一潮流，引发熔岩运动热潮。悬浮艇飞越熔岩流的画面迅速成为§Y[planet.GetName]§!本地文化象征。

遗憾的是，热情让人忽略了安全问题，不断有零星的赛艇致死报告出现。不法放贷者似乎也在利用熔岩运动爱好者的赌博癖好牟利。虽然公众支持度很高，我们仍需持续监控其可能产生的负面影响。
descriptions.en:
Allowing colonists to pursue this trend has generated a boom of excitement around lava sports. Images of pilot veering their hovercraft above lava flows are quickly becoming a symbol of §Y[planet.GetName]§!'s local culture.

Unfortunately, enthusiasm has eclipsed safety. Sporadic reports of racing deaths continue to come in, and it appears criminal money lenders are exploiting the gambling habits of lava sports enthusiasts. While public approval for the sport remains high, we should continue to monitor negative consequences in the future.

descriptions.zh:
起初，殖民者反感帝国当局干预他们的爱好，但新增的赛艇安全措施几乎杜绝了上网事故，选手开始赞扬这些规定对自身安全的保障作用，公众也逐渐认可。

熔岩运动相关的赌博产业也开始实行财务透明和征税制度，收益用于选手安全装备。尽管少数殖民者仍抱怨当局征税不公，但赌博场所中的犯罪分子已基本散去。
descriptions.en:
While colonists initially resented imperial authorities arriving to regulate their beloved pastime, the new safety measures required on racing craft have almost eliminated injuries and fatalities. Racing pilots are speaking up about the benefits of these regulations to their own safety, which is bringing the public on board.

Financial transparency and taxation have also been imposed on lava sports gambling, with proceeds going to safety outfitting for the racers. Criminal elements have mostly dispersed from the gambling dens, though some colonists complain that taxation by authorities is unjust.

label.zh: 安全为重，有些事一旦发生就晚了。

descriptions.zh: 执法部门已出手遏止这一危险行为。尽管公众强烈抗议，殖民地各地爆发示威。但熔岩流受到持续监控，选手也无法参赛，死亡人数降至零，赌博场所也几乎消失。
descriptions.en: Law enforcement has been deployed to put a stop to this dangerous practice. Public outcry against enforcement has been powerful and protests have occured throughout the colony, but with the lava flows under constant surveillance and racers unable to compete, deaths have dropped to zero, and the gambling scene has all but evaporated.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!前超光速物种的成员与我们最古老神话中的神灵极为相似，这可以部分归因于趋同进化和心理学的普遍规律，但随着我们对该物种了解的加深，联系愈发明显。

它们会是我们神话传说中的生物吗？这一可能引发了广泛关注，可以投入资源推进研究。但有时，巧合的累积并无更深含义，过度探究可能暴露我们的存在，引发不可预见的后果。
descriptions.en:
Members of the pre-FTL species on §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! have striking similarities to mythological beings from some of our oldest myths. Some of this may be accounted for by broad trends in convergent evolution and psychology, but the more we learn about this species, the more connections we find.

Could these be the same beings from our myths and legends? There is increasing excitement at this prospect, and we could invest in pushing this research further. But sometimes coincidences pile up without deeper meaning, and too much prying could reveal our presence to this society, causing unintended consequences.

descriptions.zh: 虽有人呼吁展开调查，但进一步追寻神话外星人的假设并不明智。毕竟，该物种拥有自身的神话、传说和自我认知，可能与我们的预设大相径庭。现已暂停相关研究，并将资金重新分配到其他领域。
descriptions.en: Despite some calls to investigate, it would be unwise to chase this hypothesis of mythological aliens any further. After all, this species has its own myths, legends, and ways of seeing itself, which may not fit well with our own preconceptions. Research on the topic has been paused, with funds redirected to other concerns.

descriptions.zh:
因急于将该物种与神话联系起来，我们的特工忽视了前超光速接触的安全协议。行星各处的当地居民已多次记录我方舰船的踪迹，窃取我们的设备，有一次甚至绑架了我们的一名特工进行研究。该物种得知我们的存在后，产生了骚乱与截然不同的反应。

尽管行动过程一片混乱，这种神话层面的联系却令我方公众激动不已，帝国上下都在以一种精神性视角审视该物种。
descriptions.en:
In our eagerness to link this species to our myths, our agents neglected safe pre-FTL contact protocol. Across the planet, locals have recorded multiple observations of our ships, have stolen equipment, and in one case, kidnapped one of our agents for study. Learning of our existence has caused unrest and polarized responses.

Despite the operational chaos, excitement about the mythological connections persist among our own people. This species is being viewed through an increasingly spiritual lens across our empire.

label.en: We should have been more careful.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!居民的深入研究否认了神话假说，虽然两者存在许多相似之处，但仍发现了不可调和的差异。

尽管情况越加复杂，但人们对该物种的兴趣依然高涨。有观点认为，他们是我们故事中原始生灵的残余种群，而差异则源于漫长的时光流逝。虽不得不承认他们如今已形成独立社会，帝国内部仍有许多人感到与他们存在强烈的精神联系。
descriptions.en:
Intensive study of the inhabitants of §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! have cooled the mythological hypothesis. While many parallels are found between our oldest stories and these beings, some irreconcilable differences have also been uncovered.

Despite this more complicated picture, enthusiasm for this species remains. It has been suggested that they may be a remnant population of the original beings in our stories, and that differences may be due to the vast spans of time elapsed since. While we are forced to recognize them as their own society today, many in our empire now feel a strong spiritual connection to them.

label.zh: 于我们而言，这是非常重大的收获。
label.en: An enriching moment for all of us.

descriptions.zh:
我方部队已全面掌控该空间站。当地居民虽曾抵抗，但其装备简陋，且缺乏战争经验，许多人甚至尚未成年。幸存者均已被拘押。

我们已着手研究如何控制那些亚空间隧道，它们似乎是一种能源开采虹吸装置。假以时日，我们或许就能解决母星系正面临的问题。
descriptions.en:
Our forces have seized control of the station. The inhabitants put up some resistance, but were poorly armed and seemingly untrained in warfare. Upon closer inspection, many appeared to be juveniles. Those who were not killed have been contained.

Analysis has begun on how we can control the subspace tunnels, which appear to be some sort of energy-mining siphon. With time, we can address the situation in our home system.

label.zh: 幸存者构成威胁，予以剿灭。
label.en: The survivors are a risk. Eliminate them.

descriptions.zh:
亚空间开采站被摧毁，里面人员全部死亡。

摧毁开采站引爆了某种未知能量储备介质，释放的能量通过坍塌的亚空间隧道涌入§Y[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]§!，致其局势急剧恶化。

不过，向恒星输送氢气的过程已经停止。情况虽然糟糕，但不至于继续恶化。尽管我们可能永远无法了解此开采站的起源与设计，但至少能放心，因为这种力量永远不会落入对手手中。

遗憾的是，我们暂时没有办法让§Y[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]§!立即复原。若想影响恒星状态，只能依靠记录还原开采站运作。
descriptions.en:
The subspace mining station has been destroyed, killing everyone on board.

The destruction of the station detonated some unknown energy storage medium. The resulting energy rushed through the collapsing subspace tunnel into §Y[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]§!, substantially worsening the situation back home.

That said, the transfer of hydrogen into our star has ceased. As bad as things may be, they will no longer worsen. While we may never know the origins or design of this station, we can at least rest easy knowing that such power will never fall to our rivals.

Unfortunately, we have no immediate way to return §Y[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]§! to its original state. If we want to affect the star's state, we'll need to rely on our recordings to piece together what the station was doing.

descriptions.zh: 开采站残骸漂浮在太空中，它的毁灭为我们带来一次改变§Y[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]§!命运的新机遇，不过并非唾手可得，而是需要艰苦付出。
descriptions.en: As the station's remains drift through space, its destruction offers us a new chance to change the fate of §Y[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]§!, not with the flip of a switch, but through hard, costly labor.

options.script: name = ACKNOWLEDGED

descriptions.zh:
历经漫长而艰辛的研究，我们终于研发出基础翻译装置，得以与开采站的居民进行交流。

这座开采站已经运行了数代，在气态巨行星之间不断迁移，通过亚空间虹吸装置从遥远恒星中抽取能量，为生命维持系统与强大跃迁引擎的运转供能。

外星居民并未完全理解系统机制，也未察觉他们的虹吸目标为恒星，最终致恒星毁灭。

尽管有些困惑，但他们迫切希望离开这里，并承诺将自身的知识与技术传授给我们，换取一个安全的居住地与孕育后代的家园。
descriptions.en:
After a lengthy and difficult process, we have a rudimentary translator that can communicate with station inhabitants.

The station has been operating for generations, moving from gas giant to gas giant, using the subspace siphon to extract energy from distant stars to power their life support and powerful jump drive.

The aliens do not fully understand the systems they are operating and did not realize that their siphoning targeted stars and eventually destroyed them.

Despite their confusion, they seem eager to leave the station. They have promised to teach us what they know in exchange for a safe place to live and raise their young.

label.zh: 赠予飞船让其自寻出路。
label.en: Give them a ship to find their own path.

label.zh: 允许他们自行评判我们。
label.en: Allow them to make their own judgment of us.

descriptions.zh:
开采站从气态巨行星虹吸氢气，通过亚空间隧道输送至恒星外层，引发氦聚变反应，释放出过剩能量，再将能量转化为§Y结晶熵§!，为站点供能。

导致§Y[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]§!不稳定的根源在于居民未能察觉或无法修复的校准误差与设备老化。

借助他们古老的技术，我们有可能将这一进程逆转，但难度极高。另一个可行的方案是诱导恒星发生新星爆发，使大量矿藏暴露出来，成为方便开采的资源。
descriptions.en:
The station siphons hydrogen from a gas giant and channels it through subspace into our star's shell. The resulting helium fusion releases excess energy, which is converted into §YCrystallized Entropy§! to power the station.

The instability of §Y[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]§! is a result of calibration errors and equipment degradation that the inhabitants either didn't notice or didn't know how to fix. 

Working with their ancient technology we can reverse the process, but it will not be easy. Alternatively, forcing our star to go nova could expose countless deposits transforming our heritage into a trove of exploitable resources.

label.en: It's time to get to work.

descriptions.zh:
开采站从气态巨行星虹吸氢气，通过亚空间隧道输送至恒星外层，引发氦聚变反应，释放出过剩能量，再将能量转化为§Y结晶熵§!，为站点供能。

站中居民只能口述设备的运作机制，且信息未必准确。他们在数千年前便与母星失联，或许是因为其文明已然崩溃或被消灭。随着校准误差累积与设备老化，虹吸过程愈发不稳，如今甚至可能摧毁§Y[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]§!。

借助他们古老的技术，我们有可能将这一进程逆转，但难度极高。另一个可行的方案是诱导恒星发生新星爆发，使大量矿藏暴露出来，成为方便开采的资源。
descriptions.en:
The station siphons hydrogen from a gas giant and channels it through subspace into our star's shell. The resulting helium fusion releases excess energy, which is converted into §YCrystallized Entropy§! to power the station.

The inhabitants of the station retain only a warped oral tradition about its operations. They lost contact with their home civilization thousands of years ago, perhaps because that civilization collapsed or was destroyed. A buildup of calibration errors and equipment degradation has led to the increasingly unstable siphoning that now threatens to destroy §Y[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]§!.

Working with their ancient technology we can reverse the process, but it will not be easy. Alternatively, forcing our star to go nova could expose countless deposits, transforming our heritage into a trove of exploitable resources.

label.en: It's time to get to work.

descriptions.zh:
得知我们的处境后，站内居民陷入恐慌。他们自以为在宇宙中孑然一身，从未意识到星系中还有其他物种存在。

我们还没完全弄清他们究竟做了什么，他们便在懊悔之下开始自行拆除开采站，永久摧毁大部分组件。

因此，控制恒星膨胀将十分困难。我们必须决定如何处理这些不稳定的外星人，并考虑是否给予他们所期望的宽恕。
descriptions.en:
Upon learning of our plight, the station's inhabitants expressed alarm and dismay. They believed themselves alone, and were unaware of other species in the galaxy.

In a fit of remorse and before we truly grasped what they were doing, they began to dismantle the station, permanently destroying most of its components.

As a result, it will be difficult to control the star's expansion. And we must decide what to do with these volatile aliens, and whether to offer them the forgiveness they desire.

label.zh: 收留他们并修复开采站。
label.en: Take them in and salvage the station.

label.zh: 处置他们并摧毁开采站。
label.en: Dispose of them and of the station.

label.zh: 奴役他们并摧毁开采站。
label.en: Enslave them and destroy the station.

descriptions.zh:
经过艰苦卓绝的努力，我们现已完全掌控§Y[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]§!的命运。如果不加干预，它将以当前体积遵循自然生命周期运行。

然而，那座古老破败的开采站已无法承受多次的重新配置。每一次调整都在透支其设施寿命。如今，我们面前只剩一个抉择：

要么将恒星缩回原有规模；要么迫使其进一步膨胀，将整个恒星系化为容易开采的辽阔资源宝地。

我们的[GetScientistPlural]将执行最后一次重新配置，在此之后，它唯一的结局便是被外力迅速拆解。
descriptions.en:
After great effort, we now hold full control over the fate of §Y[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]§!. Left alone, it would follow its natural life cycle at its current size.

But the ancient and failing station cannot withstand repeated reconfigurations. Each adjustment strains the facility to its limits. Now, we have only one choice.

We can shrink the star back to its former size, or force it to expand, transforming the system into a vast field of easily harvested resources.

Our [GetScientistPlural] will attempt one last reconfiguration. After that, the only way forward will be rapid disassembly, by external force.

label.en: Fix the star in its current state.

descriptions.zh:
我们完全掌控恒星的体积与能量波动后，§Y[Target.GetStarName]§!终于彻底稳定下来。未来数百万年内，它都将保持当前状态，我们的人民也得以在母星系重享稳定与可预测的生活。

恒星的膨胀虽对基础设施管理造成显著影响，但我们已能化危为机，既能充分利用其增强的能量输出，又能保持在恒星系内稳定生存。
descriptions.en:
With complete control achieved over our star's fluctuating size and energy, §Y[Target.GetStarName]§! has fully stabilized. It will remain as it is now for millions of years, and our people can once again enjoy stability and predictability in our home system.

Our star's increased size has clear consequences for how we manage our infrastructure, and we can now make the most of these changes, exploiting its increased energetic output while maintaining a viable presence in the system.

label.zh: 终于，我们掌握了自己的命运。
label.en: At last, we control our destiny.

options.script: name = infernals.2145.a

descriptions.zh:
进入该恒星系后，我方舰队遭遇一群自动化子个体的短暂抵抗，迅速将其消灭后，我们得以近距离勘察外星开采站。

尽管外面有大量修补痕迹，但该设施仍在运行。在试图进入其中一个停靠舱时，我们与一个未知外星物种取得了联系。尽管有语言障碍，但可以确认该装置正是影响§Y[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]§!的次空间隧道的源头。

目前，我们正全力建立沟通，或许能够通过外交途径解决问题。但若是失败，我们可能不得不考虑更直接的方式，即登陆设施或直接摧毁。但在未彻底掌握其目的之前，贸然采取武力行动可能对恒星构成极大风险。
descriptions.en:
Upon entering the system, our vessels encountered limited resistance from a group of automated drones. These were swiftly neutralized, allowing for a closer examination of the alien station.

The structure remains operational, though its hull bears the marks of extensive patchwork repairs. Attempting to access one of its docking bays, we made contact with a previously unknown alien species. Though linguistic barriers remain, we have confirmed that this installation is the origin of the tunnels affecting §Y[event_target:situation_red_giant_target_shortterm.GetStarName]§!.

Efforts are now underway to establish communications. A diplomatic resolution may be possible. Failing that, we may be forced to consider more direct methods, boarding the facility or destroying it outright. However, without a thorough understanding of its purpose, such actions may carry significant risk to our star.

descriptions.zh:
持续研究表明，亚空间开采站以一种奇异形式储存了巨量热能，我方[GetScientistPlural]称之为§Y结晶熵§!。该设施利用热反馈循环放大能量输入。

若能复制这项技术，我们将掌握前所未有的力量，虽然许多人可能认为这不自然且危险。这样可能产生大量多余热能，但如果能找到在这种条件下生存的方法，星系将成为我们的囊中之物。
descriptions.en:
Ongoing study of the subspace mining station suggests that it stores massive amounts of thermal energy in an exotic form, which our [GetScientistPlural] are calling §YCrystallized Entropy§!. It leverages thermal feedback loops to magnify energy inputs.

By replicating this technology, we could learn to wield previously unimaginable power that many would deem unnatural and dangerous. Doing so may produce vast amounts of excess heat, but if we are able to find a way to thrive in such conditions, the galaxy may be ours for the taking.

descriptions.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]遗迹初看似由石头构成，但挖掘和分析表明，许多建筑由石化的类木材有机物构成。现今行星上已无该材料来源。小型文物由粗制金属、玻璃及类似的石化有机物组成，[GetScientistPlural]还发现了已灭绝本土生物的化石。

该文明疑居于气候温和时期。他们是早已消失，还是目睹了巨变的尾声？
descriptions.en:
While the ruins on [From.Planet.GetName] first appeared to be built of stone, excavation and analysis suggests that many of the structures in this lost city are made of a petrified organic material comparable to wood. No source for such materials exists on the planet today. Smaller artifacts are built of crude metals, glass, and similar petrified organics, and [GetScientistPlural] have also found fossils of native creatures that no longer exist. 

It appears the civilization in question inhabited the planet at a time when its climate was much more temperate. Did they disappear long before the planet turned to its current state, or did they witness the violent transition in their final years?

options.script:
name = FASCINATING
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]城市废墟中挖掘出若干具有文化价值的场所，墙面饰有复杂纹样，疑为某种文字。最激动人心的是，挖掘队发现一个密布书架的地下房间，摆满刻有繁复铭文的青铜薄板。青铜作为存储介质极为低效，但这里似乎是个公共文本档案库。

考古队正深入探索并开始破译文本。该文明的最终命运仍待揭晓。
descriptions.en:
Excavation of the ruined city on [From.Planet.GetName] has revealed places of cultural importance, decorated with intricate patterns that may be a written language. Most excitingly, the dig teams have found an underground chamber full of shelves, each containing thin sheets of bronze etched with densely-packed script. Despite the inefficiency of bronze as a storage medium, this appears to be a communal archive of texts. 

Translation attempts have begun as the archaeological teams continue to spread out through the city. The question of the final fate of these people remains open.

options.script:
name = KEEP_SEARCHING
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]上的团队发现了一处阴森的地下墓穴，由纵横交错的挖掘坑道构成，壁龛里叠放着三到四层木乃伊化的外星遗骸。陪葬品反映出该文明的科技面貌：有粗糙的火器、简易的玻璃望远镜，以及精细复杂的纺织刺绣。

墓穴的多个交叉口由本地已灭绝动物的雕像把守。这些生物有圆顶甲壳、四条矮腿和小而钝的脑袋；在保存良好的雕像中，它们蜷伏着以壳护身，抵御上方刻画的火焰。

这件艺术品的真实意涵或许已随时间消逝，但它很可能反映出社会对烈焰厄运即将来临的预感。若能深入发掘，或许能澄清该文明当年所经历之事。
descriptions.en:
The team on [From.Planet.GetName] has encountered a somber catacomb. It consists of a network of dugout trenches, with mummified alien remains resting in cavities in the walls, stacked three or four individuals high. Burial goods give us a glimpse of their technological development, such as primitive firearms, simple glass telescopes, and complex textile embroidery. 

Many junctions within the catacomb are guarded by statues of extinct local fauna. These creatures have a round, domed shell, four squat legs, and a small blunt head. In better-preserved specimens, they are depicted hunching down, using their shell to protect them from flame-like carvings in the material above them. 

The true meaning of this artwork may be lost to time, but it may depict this society's awareness of its impending, fiery doom. Further excavation of the ruins may clarify what they were experiencing.

options.script:
name = DIG
medium_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
对[From.Planet.GetName]城市废墟的深入探索证明，该文明经历了生态系统的全面崩溃，并察觉到烈焰吞噬的末日逼近。最初他们以纸张记录历史，后因火山灰常年飘落，转而使用青铜板保存记录。艺术作品中频繁出现动物躲避火焰的场景，显然是在尝试理解并描绘自身的灭亡。

挖掘过程中还发现了一尊近乎完好的地下墓穴守卫雕像，其顶部雕刻的火焰散发出微弱的光芒，极具保护价值。

除此之外，我们还发现了他们试图阻止火山活动的证据，根据现存的道路与被毁的运输车可知，当地居民曾将碎石运往最近的火山口，企图封堵火山喷发，但终究未能改变灭亡的命运。如今，这颗行星早已不再存在任何多细胞生命。

此段历史警示我们，一旦遭遇超乎自身技术的难题，任何文明都岌岌可危。
descriptions.en:
Extensive exploration of the ruined city on [From.Planet.GetName] proves that this civilization lived through the collapse of its ecosystem, and knew its final, fiery days were approaching. Paper-based records existed before hot volcanic ashfall forced them to switch to bronze tablets, and artistic depictions of animals hiding from flame record their attempts to reckon with their own end. 

The excavation also uncovered a nearly perfect specimen of the catacomb guardian statues. The flames carved above it have an internal glow, making this a striking piece worthy of preservation. 

We also found evidence of attempts to stop the volcanism. Roadways and broken carts demonstrate that the inhabitants transported rubble to the nearest volcanic caldera and dumped it in to try to plug the volcano. Unfortunately, they were unable to stop their fate. The planet is devoid of multicellular life today. 

This history reminds us of the precarity of any civilization, should it encounter a problem more powerful than the tools it has at its disposal.

label.en: We should learn from their mistakes.

descriptions.zh:
神庙上存有战斗痕迹，土壤中残存当地智慧生命遗骸。神庙似被焚毁后遗弃。安保团队注意到当地居民完全避开此地，视之为诅咒。

在外墙保护下，火焰神庙内部得以保存。里面留有大量精致的壁画和雕刻，其中多次出现一圈卷曲的火焰图案，火焰中央则是一道漆黑裂隙。在一幅壁画中，一个双足生物从自己的四只眼睛中挖出一只抛向大地，形成火焰中央的图案，我们将其命名为“地狱之眼”。

后续发掘将揭示此异象相关信仰。
descriptions.en:
The temple itself is scarred by signs of battle, and there are ancient remains of the local sentient species in the soil. It seems the temple was torched and abandoned. Security teams have noted that the locals avoid this entire area, believing it to be cursed. 

The fire temple's walls protected its contents, including many intricate frescos and carvings. These feature a recurring motif of a circle of twisted fire, with a dark gash down its center. In one depiction, a bipedal figure plucks out one of four such eyes and casts it upon the world, creating this central motif. We are designating it the Infernal Eye. 

Further excavations will reveal what beliefs surrounded this strange figure.

options.script:
name = INTERESTING
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
对地狱之眼神庙的发掘显示大量祭献痕迹。神庙内有多处大型圆坑，圆坑中央设有平台，模仿地狱之眼及瞳孔。坑内积满灰烬与炭块，分子分析表明这些来自动物组织。

尚不明确祭品为野生或家养动物，还是当地居民。

特工已前往当前人口中心寻找相关证据，挖掘队继续探寻答案。
descriptions.en:
Excavations of the temple of the Infernal Eye show evidence of many sacrifices. Large circular pits with platforms in the center, mimicking the Infernal Eye and its pupil, lie filled with layers of ash and charcoal. Molecular analysis reveals that the ash and charcoal comes from animal tissue. 

Whether these sacrifices were of wild or domestic animals, or indeed of the locals themselves, cannot be determined. 

Agents have been dispatched to current population centers in search of corollary evidence, while our excavators search for more answers.

label.en: It's a mystery waiting to be solved!
Send drones to solve that mystery.

descriptions.zh:
一扇沉重的石门挡住了进入神庙最深处的路。破门后，挖掘队发现一个圆形房间，房间中央的坑洞直通地下的天然岩浆池。岩浆发出橙色光芒映红墙壁，隐约映照出环绕整个奇怪房间的铭文。墙壁顶端一周布满明亮炽热的眼睛。

坑边祭坛形似地狱之眼，上面散落着一具干枯的当地居民遗骸，疑为祭献安抚地狱之眼所用。

墙壁上的铭文对理解神庙的文化职能至关重要，应立即破译。
descriptions.en:
A heavy stone doorway was discovered blocking off the deepest part of the temple. After breaking through, excavators found a circular chamber with a central pit opening directly above a natural underground magma reservoir. The orange light of the magma bathed the walls in a red glow, faintly illuminating inscriptions encircling the strange room. The top of the surrounding walls are studded with bright, flaming eyes.

On one edge of this pit are the desiccated remains of one of the locals, broken open upon an altar shaped like the Infernal Eye. It appears they were in fact sacrificing their own in an attempt to appease it.

The text along these walls may be critical to understanding the cultural role of this temple, and should be translated immediately.

options.script:
name = INCREDIBLE
medium_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
最终研究发现，神庙最深处房间中的经文揭示了一系列围绕地狱之眼回归的预言，讲述地狱之眼因臣民蔑视燃起怒火，将使天空变暗、圣山喷发、特定作物枯萎，灾祸连绵不断。预言预示文明终结，唯有服从地狱之眼者得以幸存。

本地特工探寻其中的文化关联，发现此预言是该行星文化中许多谚语和神话的源头，而当地现代神庙所举行的神秘仪式则是对此古老预言的重新演绎或反抗。

我方技术可以重现预言中的事件，或通过伪造，以假乱真。倘若我们自诩地狱之眼转世，印证预言不虚，便能迫使对方让步并效忠于我们，为长期同化创造条件。
descriptions.en:
The final study of the scripture in the temple's innermost chamber reveals a set of prophecies relating to the return of the Infernal Eye. It speaks of the Infernal Eye growing angry at the defiance of its subjects. In response, the Eye is expected to darken the skies, erupt a specific holy mountain, cause a specific crop to wither on the vine, and more. The prophecy presents this as the end of civilization, stating that after these events, only those who submit to the Infernal Eye shall survive. 

Our agents among the local populace have looked for cultural connections, and found that this prophetic text is the source of many aphorisms and phrases in the planet's cultures, as well as the source text for many later stories and myths. They also believe that the mysteries practiced by their modern temples include variations on, and reactions against, this ancient prophecy. 

All of these prophesied events could be re-enacted with our technology, or faked with a degree of realism they will not be able to detect. If we were to present ourselves as the Infernal Eye reincarnate, demonstrating that the original prophecy was right all along, we may be able to extract concessions and fealty from them. This would make them easier to absorb in the long term.

tooltips.zh: §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!的原始社会将学会采纳我方思潮。
tooltips.en: The primitive society of §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§! will learn to adopt our ethics.

label.zh: 他们的历史已永远湮灭。
label.en: Their history has been lost forever.

descriptions.zh:
随着§Y[planet.GetName]§!殖民地的不断扩张，越来越多证据显示有一个使用活体金属的已灭绝文明曾在此活动，尽管至今未发现他们获取这种材料的任何线索。

最近出现了一个答案：一个被力场包裹、闪烁着奇异光芒的球体，从深层核心的熔岩流中缓缓升起。 其最初用途与构造尚不明朗，但在极高温度下，它会持续滴落出活体金属。这一发现虽巧妙地解开了那桩考古谜团，却也让我们面临新的抉择——该如何处置它。
descriptions.en:
As the colony on §Y[planet.GetName]§! grew, so too did evidence of an extinct civilization that made use of Living Metal, though there was no trace of where they acquired this material.

An answer has recently surfaced, in the form of a strange shimmering sphere encased in a force field which buoyed up from deep core magma flows. Its original purpose and construction are not immediately obvious, but it produces a steady drip of Living Metal when exposed to extremely high temperatures. While this handily solves that archaeological puzzle, we must now decide what to do with it.

tooltips.zh: 这件奇物是我们从未研发过的，它不仅是活体金属的一种宝贵来源，还具有科研与历史价值。
tooltips.en: This curious object is unlike anything we have developed. It is not only useful as a source of Living Metal, but also serves as a scientific and historical curiosity worth studying.

label.en: Toss it back into the lava.

tooltips.zh: 一个因无法自我调整而覆灭的种族无可歌颂。这些遗物就该被销毁，彻底消失在历史里。
tooltips.en: There is nothing to be admired about a civilization that failed to adapt and went extinct. The artifact is to be disposed of and forgotten.
